high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a selfie in front of a round mirror with a lighted border. The individual is wearing a black crop top and denim shorts, and they have long, straight hair that appears to be brown or auburn. They are also wearing a gold chain necklace and a bracelet on their left wrist. The background behind the mirror features a wooden slatted wall, which adds a rustic or natural aesthetic to the setting. There is a glimpse of an air conditioning unit or some other appliance mounted on the wall above the slatted paneling.
